verdict.rationale: Pilot delivers monthly accrual-basis financial statements including P&L and balance sheet as confirmed by both docs and customer reports, plus consolidated reporting for complex structures and AI-powered cash-flow queries. However, evidence shows delivery is monthly/on a cadence rather than explicitly 'on-demand for any period,' and cash-flow statements specifically aren't directly confirmed as a standard deliverable. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of on-demand historical period generation, confirmation of cash-flow statement (not just cash-flow modeling/AI queries) as a standard report, and independent verification of statement accuracy beyond customer testimonials.
